findings.shape: Nine short cylindrical silica frustules join through circular valve margins. Numerous selected golden-brown plastid cues lie inside a subdued transparent envelope with small mantle-granule cues.
findings.surface: Transparent cylindrical skins and circular valve junctions reveal numerous selected golden plate-like plastid cues. Fine mantle granule cues replace a uniform opaque golden tube; no Aulacoseira-like coarse areolate pattern is applied.
findings.movement: The retained linked chain undergoes a mild authored external drift. No flagella, independent swimming, division or environmental flow computation.
evidenceScope: Selected cylindrical-cell and chain diagnosis, granular/spinose mantle cues and nonmotility read. Not Aulacoseira-type coarse areolate mantle. Actual Kristian Peters photograph compared; optics and dimensions not fitted.
corrections: Distributed plastids more variably along and around individual cells after the first render repeated uniform rings.
Reduced coarse, bright mantle granules after close inspection.
findings.residual: The chain remains regular; plastids are smooth ellipsoidal plates and some are visibly faceted at close scale. Fine valve/rimoportula/spine anatomy and junction attachment are incomplete; pigment and silica optics are uncalibrated. External drift is not motility or a flow calculation.
